summary: ICICI Bank Limited files Form 6-K reporting that HDFC Bank Limited has received RBI approval to acquire up to 9.95% of ICICI Bank's paid-up share capital or voting rights within one year. The approval is subject to conditions including compliance with statutory/regulatory provisions. No price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a regulatory milestone in a potential stake acquisition by HDFC Bank in ICICI Bank. Watch for HDFC Bank's actual purchase initiation and any regulatory updates; the approval expiry creates a one-year clock.
